About Me

Vivien Bieliková

Teaching English where it actually happens.

Innovative and dedicated English and Music educator with over 30 years of experience in secondary and adult education.

Skilled in developing AI-enhanced and inclusive digital content, coordinating international education programs (Erasmus+, Comenius), and delivering professional development workshops.

Specialist in CLIL, digital pedagogy, and educational coaching. Fluent in English and experienced in teaching general, business, and conversational English online.

Passionate about supporting diverse learners and empowering educators through modern technologies.
